text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (――My body feels burning hot. ...――Incredible.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(I've watched the race footage and seen their training.
And I imagined it—what it would be like to compete today.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(It was completely different.
It's so fun... so wonderful...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (This is—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What incredible energy!
So this is the Classic Triple Crown route!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Just like last year, it was a high-level battle!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth A
text_block_list.text:
What the heck?! Incredible!
Are those girls seriously only in the Classic class?!

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth A
text_block_list.text: Laurel is way too crazy too...! It's not just Brian, this year's lineup is in a whole different dimension...!

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth B
text_block_list.text: The strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth B
text_block_list.text:
The strongest! Truly the strongest!
The one standing before us now is surely the 'strongest in history' who will rewrite everything...!

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth B
text_block_list.text: "We finally get to witness history in the making—the birth of a legend!"

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth A
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Man, so this is the Triple Crown trail...!
I can't even imagine what the Derby's gonna be like...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...Right.
This is only the first race of the Classic Triple Crown.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(The next one is... surely the one everyone is waiting for.
Surely, for you as well—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
……!
I want to do more, too—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after the race. Taking advantage of the time
before the live concert, I decided to take
Sakura Laurel to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
You're very thorough, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Better than getting found out later, right?
Better than getting found out later, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel triumphed in a fiercely contested battle.
In all that excitement, it's possible the pain in her body was completely numbed.
choice_data_list: (I should get a checkup just to be safe.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... This year's generation is insane...
And this is only the first race of the Classic Triple Crown...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"I'm on Team Narita Brian!
I've got my eyes on her this year!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Her older sister is super strong too!
She'll be even stronger by the next Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone seems to be in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I understand why you'd feel that way, though.
Even I, the one who actually ran—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Just like with BNW last year,
the Classic Triple Crown really is something incredible.

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
Right~! But the Nippon Derby
is totally different from the Satsuki Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
It's the dream stage for everyone involved in racing, so to speak...
And the hype is on a whole other level! It's incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The medical examination at the hospital showed
no other abnormalities beyond what had already been explained.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Now we can breathe a sigh of relief♪

text_block_list.name: Reception
text_block_list.text:
Number 58.
Your checkout is ready,
so please come to the reception desk.
choice_data_list: They called for me, so wait here for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then I shall wait for you over there.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, thank goodness.
Laurel-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Sensei?
What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to let you know one thing.
For now, the examination didn't find any issues, but—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—In this race...
you were just one step away from disaster, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: As her attending physician, I make sure to watch the footage. Please let her trainer know later too.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Surpassing that is dangerous.
No matter how strongly you desire it."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Well, about that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Even if that means it's my one and only Derby?"

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Yes. If you don't want this to be the last time.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: "...Can you tell Trainer? If it feels too difficult, I can—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...! I'm completely fine!
Excuse me, then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After taking care of various matters,
I meet up with Sakura Laurel
and leave the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...
I have to hurry so I make it in time for the concert.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're the star of the show today, after all.
Yeah, you're the star of the show today after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Ah, and also, Teacher said—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah, ummm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best!"—that's
the cheer I ended up receiving.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Therefore, it's all right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(If I pay close enough attention,
good things can happen too.)
